# `bbn`

Batch correction with BioBatchNet + UMAP/Leiden post-processing

- Wrapper: [`job_biobatchnet.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_biobatchnet.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_biobatchnet`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.basic_process_biobatchnet`

## Inputs

- biobatchnet.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- biobatchnet.batch_correction_obs must exist in AnnData.obs

## Outputs

- biobatchnet.output_adata_path (default general.anndata_path)
- outputs/<execution_id>_BioBatchNet_Integration/ (legacy direct fallback: general.qc_folder)

## Configuration

- general, biobatchnet, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl bbn
```
